answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 15201 Country: BH Title: assalamo alaikum sheikh is it permissible to celebrate 27th rajab, kunda, shabebarat, quran khani, fateha, wearing taweez etc. in islam , as me and my family celebrate the above. i will appreciate ur answer in detail. thanks & jazakallah! Question: assalamo alaikum sheikh is it permissible to celebrate 27th rajab, kunda, shabebarat, quran khani, fateha, wearing taweez etc. in islam , as me and my family celebrate the above. i will appreciate ur answer in detail. thanks & jazakallah! Answer ID: 15201 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1331/1331=M/1430) The kunda of Rajab, the halwa of 15 th Shaban and performing Fatihah keeping the food before oneself are baseless acts not supported by the Shariah. They must be avoided. The prevalent collective Quran Khwani is also makrooh. Tawiz, if contains Quranic verses, authentic duas, is allowed to wear, but it is wrong to consider the tawaiz effective, but tawizs consisting of polytheistic wordings are unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
